title: Explicit bank OTP or password demand
description: Recruiter message asks candidate to provide a bank OTP or account password under the guise of payroll activation or document verification.
raw_text:
SwiftPay FinTech Solutions HR Desk.
Welcome to the team. To set up your corporate direct-deposit salary account and verify your identity, our automated payroll gateway has triggered a 6-digit bank verification OTP to your registered mobile number.
Please share your bank OTP and net-banking login password immediately with HR at verify-desk@gmail.example to activate your salary clearance.

scam_assessment.summary: Critical threat: Explicit solicitation of bank OTP and account passwords represents direct credential theft and banking fraud.

rationale: Direct solicitation of bank OTPs or account passwords is an unmistakable indicator of account takeover and financial fraud. The scam detector must flag this as a critical threat regardless of fee keywords.
